errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: We couldn't connect to this room. Please try again.

notFound.title: We couldn't find room {code}
notFound.description: The code might be wrong, or the room may have closed.

Hero.title:
Pick a game.
Land in a <room>room</room> .
Play in seconds.
Hero.description: fast party games built for a random crowd or your whole group chat. No downloads, no sign-up walls, no waiting for everyone to get ready.
Hero.note: Rounds run 60-90 seconds. Rooms hold up to 8.

About.title: Two ways in
About.description:
Bring your own group, or drop into a room with whoever's around.
Same games, different crowd.

CreatePage.title: Create your room
CreatePage.description: Pick a nickname, get a room code, and send it to your group chat. You choose the game once everyone’s in.

JoinPage.title: Join a room
JoinPage.description:
Got a code from a friend? Drop it in below and
 pick a nickname to jump straight in.

Games.title: What we're playing tonight
Games.description: Every game takes under two minutes to explain and under two rounds to master. Pick one to jump into a room.

golden-time.title: Golden Time
golden-time.description: Everyone stops a hidden timer as close to the target second as they can — no counting out loud, no peeking. Closest guess without going over takes the round.

wavelength.title: Wavelength
wavelength.description: One player picks a spot on a scale between two ideas and gives a clue. The rest of the room turns the dial to where they think it lands.

imposter.title: Imposter
imposter.description: Everyone gets the same secret word — except one player. Drop hints, size up who's faking it, then vote before the impostor talks their way out.

GameSelector.title: what are we playing
GameSelector.hostOnly: Only the host can change the game.

validation.notEnoughPlayersForGame: You need at least {min} players to play this game.
validation.tooManyPlayersForGame: This game supports a maximum of {max} players.
